user.title: Add notification channel
user.description: An Android notification channel with its own importance, vibration and LED color. Sound and other details can be changed in the phone's settings for this channel.

data_description.channel_name: Shown in the phone's notification settings.
data_description.importance: High and maximum pop up on the screen; low and minimal arrive silently.
data_description.vibration: Milliseconds, alternating pause and vibration, for example 0, 500, 250, 500. Empty uses the default.
data_description.led_color: Only on phones with a notification LED.

reconfigure.title: Change notification channel
reconfigure.description: Android fixes these settings when a channel is created. After a change, Pinned Push deletes the channel on the phones; the next notification creates it again. Sound settings changed on the phone are reset.

data_description.channel_name: Shown in the phone's notification settings.
data_description.importance: High and maximum pop up on the screen; low and minimal arrive silently.
data_description.vibration: Milliseconds, alternating pause and vibration, for example 0, 500, 250, 500. Empty uses the default.
data_description.led_color: Only on phones with a notification LED.

error.reserved_channel: This name is reserved by the Companion App.
error.duplicate_channel: A channel with this name already exists.
error.invalid_vibration: Use numbers separated by commas, for example 0, 500, 250, 500.

no_recipients.message: No phone found for {notification}. Check the people and phones of this notification.

unknown_notification.message: {entity_id} is not a Pinned Push notification.

missing_recipients.title: Pinned Push: phone not found for {notification}
missing_recipients.description:
No Companion App could be found for: {recipients}.

For a person, select their phone under Settings → People → tracked devices, or log in to the Companion App with that person's user. For a phone, check that it is still registered in the Mobile App integration.

This message disappears with the next successful send.

renamed_buttons.title: Pinned Push: renamed button still used for {notification}
renamed_buttons.description:
The button labels {labels} no longer exist in {notification}, but these automations still use them: {automations}.

The buttons are now called {current}. Update the automations; this message disappears once no automation uses the old labels.

resend_limit.title: Pinned Push: {notification} keeps disappearing
resend_limit.description:
{notification} was dismissed {count} times and is not shown again until it is sent next time.

If you did not swipe it away yourself, the phone removes it on its own. Exclude the Companion App from battery optimization and allow it to show notifications.

send.name: Send
send.description: Sends a pinned notification, or replaces it if it is already showing.

title.name: Title
title.description: Replaces the configured title for this send.

message.name: Message
message.description: Replaces the configured message for this send.

persons.name: People
persons.description: Replaces the configured people and phones for this send.

image.name: Picture
image.description: Replaces the configured picture for this send, for example /api/camera_proxy/camera.door.

click_action.name: When tapped, open
click_action.description: Replaces the configured page for this send.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Removes an open notification from all phones without an answer.

options.snooze: Close, show again after the minutes
